mentions.name: looot.ai
mentions.description: This service connects AI models to tools on a pay-per-use basis, with no subscription required, enabling an AI to access the best tools.
mentions.problem: AI models had become very good, but lacked a connection to tools.
mentions.source_excerpt:
AI models have gotten so good, that we felt that what we were missing was the connection to the tools, so I built

https://looot.ai/

No subscription, pay-per-use to allow your AI to access the best tools.
